meta.description: Extraction / question-generation test set: 12 experiment aims drawn from typical Virtual Labs experiments (electronics, optics, mechanics, fluids, materials).

aims.aim: To study the characteristics of a common-emitter amplifier and determine its voltage gain, input impedance, and output impedance as a function of frequency.
To verify Ohm's law and determine the resistance of a given wire using a voltmeter and ammeter.
To determine the wavelength of sodium light using Newton's rings apparatus.
To measure the acceleration due to gravity using a compound pendulum.
To study the V-I characteristics of a PN junction diode in forward and reverse bias.
To determine the coefficient of viscosity of water by Poiseuille's method using a capillary tube.
To verify the laws of series and parallel combination of resistors using a multimeter.
To study the Hall effect in a semiconductor and determine the Hall coefficient and carrier concentration.
To calibrate a thermocouple and use it to determine unknown temperatures.
To determine the Young's modulus of a wire using Searle's apparatus.
To study the frequency response of a low-pass RC filter and determine its cutoff frequency.
To determine the magnetic susceptibility of a paramagnetic salt using Quincke's method.
